principalConclusion: ARA must represent practice purpose, cognitive demand, response form, validity, evaluation authority, credit, attempt sequence, reveal, feedback, consequence, accessibility and instrumentation as distinct but composable dimensions. AraLearn remains the first coherent non-punitive reference profile, not a universal default.
recommendedPath: Preserve the AraLearn low-consequence self-directed profile as a versioned reference profile.
Accept the P1 parameter dimensions into the first taxonomy while keeping implementation scope selective.
Separate learning practice from measurement and consequential assessment.
Use concise actionable elaborated feedback as the recommended formative profile rather than correctness-only feedback.
Keep reveal, retries, scoring and stakes explicit and profile-dependent.
Treat accessibility accommodations as a higher-precedence overlay rather than an ordinary learner preference.
Keep attempt-level telemetry off by default and defer its normative design to P4 and Issue #5.
Proceed to P2 before defining mastery, progression or sequencing defaults.

deferredCandidates.reason: Event availability does not authorize collection; consent, retention, construct and prohibited inference rules are not yet defined.
Potential diagnostic value exists, but burden, accessibility and interpretation require separate analysis.

deferredCandidates.destination: later research, product and architecture decisions
deferredCandidates.reason: Validity, fairness, transparency, contestability and authority remain insufficient for default consequential use.
Same-item, equivalent-item, failed-step and later-review policies depend on progression and domain semantics.

rejectedOrNotRecommended: One monolithic exerciseMode or feedbackMode as the complete practice contract.
Correctness-only feedback as the universal formative default.
Always reveal or never reveal as a universal rule.
Immediate or delayed feedback as a universal rule.
Deriving score, grade, mastery or rank from structural completion.
Inferring attention, effort, ability or difficulty from attempt count by default.
Automatic grade contribution for every practice activity.
Public ranking or leaderboards in the first active taxonomy.
Probabilistic assistance as the sole final authority for consequential decisions.
Collecting events merely because the implementation can emit them.
risks: Combinatorial explosion and incoherent parameter combinations.
Treating taxonomy acceptance as implementation authorization.
Comparing scores produced by incompatible formats and attempt policies.
Excessive or generic feedback increasing cognitive load.
Consequential assessment contaminating ordinary study and increasing anxiety.
Treating accessibility as a late exception rather than a structural requirement.
Persisting attempt data without a legitimate research or personal-analytics purpose.
decisionChangingUncertainties: Effects of unlimited retry for adult worker-students in fragmented study.
Fair aggregation of multiple attempts in formal courses.
Use of equivalent items as mastery evidence.
Multi-day feedback timing in authentic learning contexts.
Accessibility of complex structured responses on modest smartphones.
Validity and contestability of AI feedback for open responses.
Transfer to Brazilian, Portuguese and other non-WEIRD contexts.
Cognitive burden of confidence judgements and mandatory explanations.
Cases in which response time is legitimately part of the target construct.
